body:
New parents face hundreds of decisions while getting ready for baby. From the fun decisions like what to register for, what kind of shower they’d like, and what color to paint the nursery, to more significant choices like where and how to give birth and what parenting advice to follow. Baby and children’s furniture brand dadada Baby is making at least one decision much simpler for parents by providing them with a product that’s designed to grow along with their baby - the Domino-to-Grow Crib.

Instead of a crib that will ultimately need to be replaced by a toddler bed, the Domino-to-Grow transitions from a crib to a safe, secure place for their toddler to sleep. Three mattress positions accommodate a baby’s growth from newborn - standing, and with the addition of dual guard rails from the toddler conversion kit (sold separately), parents can quickly and easily transform the Domino-to-Grow crib into an adorable toddler bed.

And it IS adorable! One of the stand-out features of the Domino-to-Grow is its modern, of-the-moment design. Striking Scandinavian-inspired geometric lines make the contemporary GREENGUARD Gold certified crib a stand-out design choice for nurseries, with natural beechwood accents, well-grounded legs for stability, and quality finishing touches that are designed to withstand teething, tumbles, and generations of love.

It’s easy to be overwhelmed by all the decisions that come with new parenthood. But for new parents everywhere, the Domino-to-Grow crib is a simple choice that can make life just a little bit easier. To learn more about the Domino-to-Grow, or dadada Baby’s other modern furniture offerings, visit dadadababy.com.
